## Controller 1.0.51
### Android - **Trigger-to-card Sea Glass lens morphs.** Tapping the composer `+` Attach button, Send long-press, Context Window ring, Model chip, conversation header pill, or chat actions button morphs a liquid Sea Glass lens directly out of the control's screen coordinates into the expanded card or sheet and retracts smoothly back on close. - **120 Hz motion & spring tuning.** Locks high-refresh-rate rendering across animations, eliminates per-frame backdrop blur thrashing, and tunes open/close spring stiffness to match iPhone transition timing. - **Swipe-to-full-page action sheets.** Swipe up anywhere on a floating Sea Glass sheet to expand from the compact detent to full page with a full-bleed Sea Glass tint wash, and swipe down to step back or dismiss. - **Context Window card & morphing Inbox search.** Aligns the 18 dp composer Context Window ring and floating multi-segment Context Usage card with iPhone, and separates the Inbox Search button into a circular Sea Glass control that morphs horizontally into the full-width search bar. - **In-card model menus & Sea Glass composer overlays.** Replaces popup menus in the Model Card with an in-card choice face for Speed tiers and model options, and renders composer `+` Attach and Send long-press menus as blurred Sea Glass overlays. - **Refined touch states & ripples.** Removes 3D perspective tilt and drag tint shifts across Sea Glass controls, clips button ripples cleanly to oval pills and cards, and fixes a radial gradient color-space crash on touch.
### Mac and iPhone - **Faster workspace switching & lower idle CPU.** Eliminates background 1 Hz relative-time layout passes on hidden Settings, Usage, and Pull Request pages, scopes workspace environment updates so switching threads or Settings panes no longer invalidates the sidebar, and coarsens Connect device and provider status updates. - **Cleaner OpenCode shutdown.** Suppresses expected socket disconnects during OpenCode daemon shutdown and restart.

## Controller 1.0.51
### Android - **Expanded Sea Glass.** Floating concentric chat-actions sheet with quick actions (`Pin`, `Settle`, `Rename`, `Snooze`, `Archive`) and in-sheet `Git` and `Snooze` sub-pages; inbox long-press context menu with lifted thread preview platter, quick-action pill, and in-place `Snooze` submenu morphing; concentric SeaGlass model & effort card with temporal de-aging; and SeaGlass floating inbox dock, activity card, task plan chip, jump-to-latest button, segmented controls, and switches. - Preview images from viewed and read tool calls directly in the conversation transcript. - Drafts are created only when you type or attach content, keeping empty chats out of Drafts.
### Mac and iPhone - **WebMCP in the in-app browser.** Discover and run structured page tools exposed by websites in the built-in browser, with proactive agent steering on navigation. - Preview images from viewed and read tool calls on iPhone and iPad. - Fixes a clipped iPhone search button in the inbox toolbar, scopes iOS hang reporting to active foreground scenes, and avoids creating empty drafts before typing.

## Controller 1.0.51
### Android - **Sea Glass.** A new seafoam palette, and frosted glass that softens and bends the conversation behind the header, composer and approval cards. It's on by default; switch it off in Settings → Appearance to return to Controller blue. - Replies and code blocks are readable again in dark mode. - With the keyboard open, an approval card stays below the conversation header and scrolls inside itself.
### Mac and iPhone - The activity orb grows straight into its card and shrinks back into the orb in one smooth motion. - The context card opens and closes with the same water-drop motion as the model picker. - Codex 0.163: next-prompt suggestions, MCP sign-in results, network and permission details on command approvals, and model and effort on sub-agent rows. - OpenCode: send images, audio, video and PDFs to models that accept them. - Fixes a Mac hang while syncing preferences with iCloud, and cuts redundant sidebar, menu and titlebar redraws during background activity.
